name: How To Become A Christian
overview: Becoming a Christian involves more than verbal profession; it requires doing the will of God as Jesus taught, recognizing that salvation is rooted in faith in Him (Matthew 7:21, Mark 16:16). Jesus, who holds all authority in heaven and earth, offers the only way to the Father, granting those who receive and believe in Him the right to become children of God (Matthew 28:18, John 14:6, John 1:12). God's love is demonstrated through the gift of His only begotten Son, promising eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
